directions.You think he is not coming. I can hear i: [muttering] You think he is not coming. I can hear it in your silence. [unhinged chuckle] He is only late, friend. Kings are never early.
[gasps, awed] That light at my back... I can feel it. [ecstatic whisper] His sign, at last. [long pause] [devastated, voice breaking] But he gave it to you... [crying] A stranger in chains. [sobbing] What did you do... to be loved like that?
